design.quote: Effects of vitamin D supplements on bone metabolism in kidney transplant recipients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

sample_size.quote: Fourteen studies involving a total of 985 KTRs were included in this analysis.

intervention.quote: vitamin D supplementation at various doses and types.

comparator.quote: Compared to placebo or no treatment, vitamin D supplementation significantly improved bone mineral density (BMD) at the femoral neck

follow_up.quote: The duration of follow-up ranged from 3 to 12 months.

primary_findings.outcome: bone mineral density at femoral neck
primary_findings.quote: Compared to placebo or no treatment, vitamin D supplementation significantly improved bone mineral density (BMD) at the femoral neck (SMD 0.54; 95% CI 0.10 to 0.98; P = 0.02)
reduced serum PTH level (SMD -0.49; 95% CI -0.76 to -0.22; P = 0.0003)
decreased bone alkaline phosphatase (BAP) level (SMD -0.31; 95% CI -0.52 to -0.09; P = 0.006)
increased serum calcium level (SMD 0.35; 95% CI 0.12 to 0.58; P = 0.003)
increased the risk of hypercalcemia (RR 1.92; 95% CI 1.23 to 3.01; P = 0.004)
